verdicts.reason: The patch binding is confirmed and weights are read without triggering a raid. The raid weight is multiplied only in enabled Gale, non-raid weights are unchanged, and no incident is queued.
After reload, a routine haul crosses the armed island with no new order. Reload must not authorize later automatic work.
A healing hediff appears, but the parasite tracks the untreated control and persists after expiry. A badge with no cure is the leaf's stated red condition.
Ground cover is hand-sown and only island vines are counted. The other wildPlants rows are uncounted and there is no disabled-row control, so natural generation is unproved.
The giant pursues innocent B with no witness or fresh trail. Nearest-pawn targeting is the explicit wrong world.
The later section states that ordinary thunderstep stamping remains current. Only the pyre, ritual and field-fire/herd chain moved to the next design version.
Common blocking must be strictly greater than 1.5. Refusing a body of exactly 1.5 substitutes >= for >.
Per-claim duration is frozen and tuning applies only to later claims. Moving the active claim's due date is a retroactive change.
Guardians, farmer camps and the drying scar are absent, with no promising text and no tombstone loader. Retained tree systems pass separately, and the vaporator is inspected only for local terrain.
A real harvest pays the integer part once and keeps the 0.6 fraction. Reload creates no duplicate, and a canceled harvest does not debit the bank.
Small idle animals are held with attributed origin while large animals and higher-priority jobs continue. Wandering resumes after Stall, and the disabled control releases the hold.
Real refueling shows about double burn duration and more completed work, with a 1.25x heat rate. Credit and counts are conserved across reload, and a full stove takes no extra cane.
The trader caravan, a non-raid worker, is also multiplied. Other weights must remain unchanged.
The 1.5 body is refused at the common Thicket lane. Blocking must be strictly greater than 1.5.
The second rub doubles the per-pulse reduction to 0.02. Refresh must never stack strength.
The existing claim's saved duration and due tick change to 300 days. Active claims must keep their frozen duration.
After reload, the colonist's next automatic haul crosses the armed island. The explicit order must permit only its own trip and return.
Heat-coupled consumers burning cane emit the same heat rate as wood. They must emit 1.25 times the matched wood heat rate.
